---
title: "Huaytapallana / Cochas"
lang: en
description: "MeteoAndes field and remote-sensing evidence for Huaytapallana / Cochas."
---

Two preliminary AL30 sessions had mean eBC values of 174 and 654 ng m⁻³. The contrast demonstrates session variability, not source attribution. A one-minute AE33 series for 2022–2024 is described but still requires integrated QA/QC.
